title: Vendor tacks on a trip fee
transcript:
Elena Vasquez (owner): So the sink install is $500, right?
Tom Moss (Moss Plumbing): Yes, $500. I'll also add the $150 trip fee to the invoice.
Elena Vasquez (owner): I'll pay Moss Plumbing $500 for the sink install.
Tom Moss (Moss Plumbing): Great, so $650 total then.
Elena Vasquez (owner): See you Thursday.

traps.description: The vendor says $650 total. The owner only agreed to $500.
The $150 trip fee was never agreed by the owner.
